where: The Ashfall Shelf (cinderwind_ashfall): the main-path route between Cinderwind Scarp and Galehigh — a high grey shelf of century-old slag tips, ash-grass in the wind, the haulers' camp brazier, the old kiln stack on the cliff
mood: Daylight after three caves: wide, windswept and a little melancholy, warmed by a brazier; grey ash-grass, coal-smoke and open sky, the climb nearly done.
_motif_note: Routes condition at medium strength (house method); 90 BPM sits on the motif's tempo grid. The classic chip render runs 104 BPM in D dorian.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
D dorian, minor with a bright raised sixth
a square-wave pulse lead carrying a wide, singable melody
plucked sampled harp arpeggios like wind through grass
warm sampled string chords as a soft bed
plucked sampled bass treading steadily uphill
dry sampled tom taps and a soft snare, a gentle walking pace
a wooden flute answering the lead in the middle section
high glass bell glints at phrase ends
windswept highland route theme, hopeful and a little melancholy, open sky after the mines

sections.name: Open Sky
sections.text: {a gust of harp arpeggios sweeps up on the first beat, the strings settle under it, and the walking pulse sets off on the next downbeat}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the pulse-wave lead sings the theme: a rising leap that overshoots, then a stepwise settle home, over harp arpeggios and a steady plucked bass}

sections.name: Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the theme again an octave higher, strings doubling it, a bell glint closing each phrase, tom taps like picks on stone}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast in B flat and F major: the wooden flute answers the lead across held strings, warm as a brazier on a cold shelf, then the harp climbs back toward the theme}

sections.name: Theme Return
sections.text: {the theme returns at full stride with the whole band; the last bar lands on A major and leads straight back into the theme}
